tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search Mike Reams's posts, work items and diagrams by keyword. Returns titles, one-line summaries and canonical URLs, best match first.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read one public page (a post, work item, diagram, /about or /toolbox) as Markdown, with its canonical URL. Pass a path such as /writing/<slug> or a full mikereams.com URL.

tools.name: list_diagrams
tools.description: List the reference diagrams, including the CSDM models drawn in Blueprint Modeler, with each one's summary, page, downloadable model file and Open-in-Blueprint-Modeler link where there is one.

tools.name: list_toolbox
tools.description: Find tools, methods and learning resources from the Architect's Toolbox Guide, filtered by architecture role, kind or keyword. Returns access and license notes and a link to each entry's details and sources.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site, get_page · Private data: list_diagrams · Public sink: get_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site, get_page · Private data: list_diagrams · Public sink: get_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
